title: Your voice memo: filed, and the name and structure study started
headline: Your memo is now a brief in your own words: the book is a pragmatic walkthrough of agentic workflows, not a book about the insider agent. The storyteller leads a study of the name and the structure; synthetic tests the candidate names with its personas, the researcher checks the words against the market, the publisher keeps the listing in step. You choose. And the team now works in the day: every member is asked to move its own schedule.
